title: Apache from Herc to Missy
hook: The bongo break Kool Herc built the Bronx on.
voiceover: The bongo break Kool Herc built the Bronx on. Apache. Written by Jerry Lordan, a 1960 hit for The Shadows in the UK. Then in 1973 Michael Viner's Incredible Bongo Band cut a version in Vancouver, session drummer Jim Gordon on kit, King Errisson on bongos, and partway through the band drops out and it's just drums and bongos. Herc looped that with 2 copies at parties in the Bronx and called it the national anthem of hip-hop. Sugarhill Gang rapped over it in 1981. Nas, Made You Look, 2002. Missy Elliott, We Run This, 2006. I play the Nas and the Missy back to back and the room never clocks it's the same drums. Name a record on Apache I missed.
caption: Apache. Jerry Lordan wrote it, The Shadows had the UK hit in 1960, and in 1973 the Incredible Bongo Band (Michael Viner, Jim Gordon on drums, King Errisson on bongos) cut the version Kool Herc built the Bronx on. Sugarhill Gang, Nas's Made You Look, Missy's We Run This, and hundreds more sit on that break. Still my favourite drums to cut at 2am. Name a record on Apache I missed.
